verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs describe one built-in recurring job: Blob Storage Export, which exports large data volumes on a schedule. There is no evidence of general user-defined scheduling of jobs or workflows. Production LLM-as-a-judge evaluators run continuously on live traffic rather than on a user schedule, and CI/CD experiments rely on GitHub Actions, a host platform, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows (cron-style triggers), scheduled experiments or evaluations, schedule configuration details, independent corroboration.
